facts.fact: URA says that under section 4 of the Tax Procedures Code Act the Entity Registration Number or Business Registration Number issued by URSB serves as the tax identifier for non-individual entities, so they need no separate TIN.

UGA.note: Only the URA tax portal is mentioned, with no count of services or national gateway.
No count or share of people holding a NIN is given.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Nothing on who operates, maintains or owns the ID system.

facts.fact: URA says Cabinet approved on 1 September 2026 the NIN issued by NIRA as the primary taxpayer number for individuals, that mapping of NINs to TINs has begun, and that TIN logins end at full rollout, with NIN logins from 1 January 2027.
URA says the National Identification Number is issued by NIRA, and that people without one must obtain it from a NIRA office before registering for tax.

URA says the NIN becomes the taxpayer number for individuals after Cabinet approval on 1 September 2026, and that mapping of taxpayers' NINs to their TINs is under way, with the web portal now requiring a NIN update.
